evidence.quote: Minister Adams bluntly told Russell that while he was "willing to acquit" Gladstone of "any deliberate intention to bring on the worst effects,"
Russell replied, as guardedly as possible, that Lord Palmerston and others regretted the speech

adjudications.reason: In the revision, para 28 opens 'Russell replied' straight after a paragraph of retrospective reflection set thirty years later. The Minister's charge, which Russell's guarded neutrality assurance answers, no longer appears anywhere in the draft. The first draft's single sentence restores the exchange and its sense.

evidence.quote: When Minister Adams at last requested an interview, Russell named October 23 as the day.

adjudications.reason: No delay is mentioned before 'at last' in the revision's para 25, so the phrase is cut residue. The cheapest coherent fix is to delete 'at last'. Restoring the full delay sentence would also work but costs more words.

evidence.quote: though, to the outsider, the work seemed wasted
who did their work quietly and well. The waste was only apparent

adjudications.reason: 'The waste was only apparent' rebuts a waste that is mentioned nowhere in para 2. A short source-based clause supplies the missing antecedent.

evidence.quote: Gladstone circulated a rejoinder to G. C. Lewis, insisting on the duty of England, France, and Russia to intervene
Palmerston had no notion of letting his hand be forced by Gladstone.

adjudications.reason: This is a legitimate compression. Paras 21–24 narrate Gladstone's speech and Palmerston's repudiation through Lewis. Para 30 shows Gladstone's 24 October rejoinder and Napoleon's overture. The V6 punchline is therefore set up, and 'this motion' can be recovered from para 30.

evidence.quote: "I weakly supposed ... I really, though most strangely, believed that it was an act of friendliness."
an incapacity of viewing subjects all round

adjudications.reason: 013 quotes the 'act of friendliness' sentence itself before rebutting it, so its argument stands on its own. The plan's dependency requires only 'incredible grossness' and 'incapacity of viewing subjects all round', and both are retained in 012.

evidence.quote: Palmerston was simple--so simple as to mislead the student altogether--but scarcely more consistent.

adjudications.reason: The plan lists this passage as optional. The simplicity thesis survives in 'Palmerston was simple--so simple as to mislead the student altogether', and 'scarcely more consistent' still links back to the Russell portrait. Dropping the sentence is an acceptable tradeoff within the word budget.

remaining_concerns: 'This motion' in para 33 still relies on the reader recalling Napoleon's overture from para 30.
